title: Market Analysis for the Week of 11/8
ref_note: No roll this week (Dec contracts). ES list starts 'Will add higher if needed' and ends 'Will Add lower if needed'; NQ list starts 'See last week’s for higher' and ends 'Will add lower if needed'. NQ list line '28200-28233* Monitor for Failed reclaim' has a non-LAAF/LBAF tag, so tag is '' and no tag trade (wnq13 carries 'remaining alert for a failed reclaim' as stop_hint). Text vs list differences: ES 'August low at 7541–7543' vs list 7539-7543; NQ recap 'LBAF of 28444–28485' vs list 28443-28485; NQ deepest back-test written 25245–25275 vs list 25245-25269 (wnq3 keeps 25245-25275). ES 'September low at 7575' sits in list 7569-7575 (not repeated as a zone). ES 'this past week’s high' has no number (wes9 tgt PREV_WEEK_HIGH; Thursday RTH high 7712.5). NQ 'Thursday’s open' (wnq12 target) has no number. ES YTD VWAP 'between' 7313-7317 and 7292-7296 has no number. wes4 tgt uses the June RTH/ETH lows (7247.25, 7232.25) from the next sentence. wnq1/wnq2/wnq3 come from the multi-week 'Bigger Picture: Bull vs. Bear' section (filed under Trading Higher/Lower). Tag trades not added because a commentary long covers them: NQ 26369-26408 (wnq7 LBAF of 26366.5 'near our 26369–26408'), 25656 and 25516-25550 (wnq2 spans 25516-25656), 25245-25269 (wnq3). NQ cautions 4 and 5 have range [null,null] because the sentences state no number: #4 refers to below this past week’s low (26366.5) and former ATH; #5 to Thursday’s A-period singles above 27588-27622. Not made trades (borderline/requirements): ES 'take out Friday’s high without having the breakout bearish engulf' (requirement); ES 'In that scenario, 7388–7396 would be the first key reclaim needed' after the LBAF of 7322.25; ES 'Any attempted bullish reversal ... reclaim this past week’s low ... ideally 7388–7396' (requirement); ES sustained break above 7469-7473 'would not necessarily produce a clean rotation to 7497–7504'; ES 'Any rejection above 7469–7473 would need to produce renewed acceptance back inside Friday’s 7388–7396 to 7469–7473 distribution' and 'sellers would need to regain acceptance below 7469–7473' (requirements); ES 'A rejection here, or a LAAF within the singles, could be particularly consequential' (7539-7543, merged into wes6's level); ES 'A firm reclaim of 7569–7575 would put ES back inside September’s range' and 7645-7650 reclamation 'another meaningful step' (no target); ES 'Below the June lows ... particular attention to 7177–7186 and 7169–7170'; NQ first bullish sequence (reclaim July/May lows, accept above June low), HH/HL above this past week’s high and 29038-29069, and 'sustained acceptance above approximately 30500' → new ATH (no number targets); NQ bearish scenario 'taking out this past week’s low and the former 2025 high' (duplicate of wnq10); NQ 25990-26016 'relatively routine trappy back-test'; NQ 24069 volume = cyclical bear (zone only); NQ 'A successful rejection from there [26258-26291], followed by a reclaim of 26366.5, would bring the same upside recovery requirements back into focus'; NQ 'press shorts in ES' on NQ weakness (no level); NQ rejection within A-period singles 'could quickly send NQ back toward Friday’s high' (no gate number); NQ 'Any defense by sellers above Friday’s high must ultimately produce firm acceptance back within Friday’s range' (requirement).

cautions.quote: If those lows are taken out, I’ll pause for a fresh structural assessment, much as we did when NQ took out its July low.
A-period singles have been particularly reactive this year, so I won’t assume a clean first-pass rotation to 7619–7624 following a reclaim of 7569–7575.
Given our proximity to such an important higher-timeframe back-test, I’m still not particularly comfortable initiating shorts even below 26718–26732.
That does not, however, mean I have much interest in initiating NQ shorts at such an extended and structurally significant location.
A-period singles have been notably reactive throughout this year, so I would be cautious about assuming a clean rotation through them on the first attempt.
